body:
**Type:** Bug · **Priority:** P0

## Cross-repository ownership

This issue owns the **Hive Mind implementation** for [Formal AI #1484](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/issues/1484). That Formal AI issue owns integration acceptance across both repositories. Neither issue is complete merely because the other has been opened.

## Reproduction and current source

The [2026-10-30 issue-created draft, run 41081977243/job 124153176671](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/41081977243/job/124153176671), used wrapper and serving backend **0.355.15** around 15:41 UTC. [Formal AI v0.355.23](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/releases/tag/v0.355.23) was already published at 04:10:32 UTC that day.

Reviewed Hive main: `279ac05609d2a791c184c4f9fe7ee071e40ef6a4` (2.39.9), still current when this issue was prepared.

- [Dockerfile](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/279ac05609d2a791c184c4f9fe7ee071e40ef6a4/Dockerfile) defaults `FORMAL_AI_VERSION=0.355.15`.
- [formal-ai-draft.mjs](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/279ac05609d2a791c184c4f9fe7ee071e40ef6a4/scripts/formal-ai-draft.mjs) replaces the baked binary only when a caller explicitly supplies one.
- [formal-ai-draft-image.lib.mjs](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/279ac05609d2a791c184c4f9fe7ee071e40ef6a4/scripts/formal-ai-draft-image.lib.mjs) can fall back from the selected version to `latest`.
- Formal AI's own issue workflow already supplies a current-main binary. Hive's own issue-open path lacks equivalent selection.

The serving-version probe exists; this is a runtime-selection defect, not a missing log line. Bumping the Docker argument once does not prevent recurrence.

## Required change

1. At live-attempt admission, resolve the intended Formal AI and Hive sources once and record the immutable attempt identity.
2. Reuse the existing caller-binary mount and artifact mechanisms to obtain a binary from the selected source. Accept a trusted matching build or produce one through the supported CI path; do not introduce a second incompatible provenance protocol.
3. Bind source SHAs, package versions, effective build identity, binary digest, image digest, client/adapter versions and actual serving identity. Version equality alone is insufficient.
4. Remove silent fallback to an unqualified backend or image. Missing artifacts produce a distinct infrastructure/deferred outcome and preserved evidence.
5. Keep live-current, published-release qualification and historical replay modes separate.
6. Coordinate with Formal AI #1486 for build/layer reuse; freshness must work even before the latency optimization is complete.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Build a Hive image, advance Formal AI, then open an issue: the attempt uses the newly selected Formal AI source.
- [ ] Verify the selected source/artifact and actual serving process before task effects.
- [ ] Missing or mismatched exact artifacts cannot silently become an older image or `latest`.
- [ ] Retries retain one attempt identity; selecting a new source starts a new identity.
- [ ] Fast tests cover drift, mismatch, missing artifacts and historical-mode labeling.
- [ ] Hosted issue-created attempts in both repositories satisfy the shared contract, with links in Formal AI #1484.

## Dependencies

No hard prerequisite to begin this fix. **Blocks:** link-assistant/formal-ai#1484's cross-repository completion.

Related older work: #2207 and #2208 address different sidecar lifecycle/version-reporting defects. Reuse those fixes rather than reimplementing them.
title: [Bug][P0] Issue-created Formal AI drafts use the stale backend baked into Hive's image
